mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, default_type, default_scope, subject_template, body_template, validation_pattern, validation_hint, updated_at FROM git_commit_setting WHERE id = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO git_commit_setting ( id, enabled, default_type, default_scope, subject_template, body_template, validation_pattern, validation_hint, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{enabled}, #{defaultType}, #{defaultScope}, #{subjectTemplate}, #{bodyTemplate}, #{validationPattern}, #{validationHint}, #{updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled = VALUES(enabled), default_type = VALUES(default_type), default_scope = VALUES(default_scope), subject_template = VALUES(subject_template), body_template = VALUES(body_template), validation_pattern = VALUES(validation_pattern), validation_hint = VALUES(validation_hint), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
